notes.title: [Patch] Demo Patch 1 - 2025.08.27
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646989/999c8e5fe25437ebe0f4a6e2805a29275e3d6e17.jpg"]

We hope you've been enjoying the Lumines Arise Demo. Be sure to play before the demo period ends on September 3, 2025, at 11:59 pm local time. We have just released the first patch to the Demo, and here’s what it addresses:
DEMO PATCH 1 - 2025.08.27
Bug Fixes and Improvements

\[ALL] Fixed a bug that caused a connection error right before a Burst Battle match.

\[ALL] Fixed an issue where a login error could appear when starting up the game.

\[ALL] Text localization updates for Chinese. 修复部分中文本地化问题

If you run into problems running or playing the Demo, please check the Support page of the lumines.game website or file a support ticket on Zendesk.
